plan: Controls of the blind stage 4 review of #1015, #1017 and #1020 (lane r127-1118), stated before any program of this lane read a certificate. Each outcome is a rule over the original file's exact facts (method A's margins and clearances, and the closed form), since those facts are unknown when this is written. 'Contact' is a margin or clearance of exactly 0; 'past' is 1e-30 beyond it. W is the least clearance at the right or top wall. A control comes out as stated when the decision of the modified packing, by both methods with equal classes, matches its rule in every part.

tiers.first: each report's centre file n127_exact.json: every control
tiers.twin: each report's witness file n127_witness.yaml: the controls that change one square or only the side, the reader controls in its own form, T0, T1 and C0; the whole-packing controls G6-G9, S2, W2, K, PALL and WALL repeat full decisions of the same squares, and T0 is what says the twin holds them exactly

trivial_checkers: Each first file is also run with --checker always-accept and with --checker always-refuse. A checker that cannot refuse must fail every must_refuse control; one that cannot accept must fail every must_accept control. Both runs must therefore report SOME_CONTROL_NOT_AS_STATED, with exactly those controls (and the decided_by_the_facts ones whose fact-derived verdict differs from the constant) not as stated. C0, PALL and WALL compare exact values rather than verdicts and are skipped in those runs, which list them as missing.
no_subject: P0p has no subject when no pair touches, and that outcome is as stated. P1 and W1 have no subject when no pair or square is eligible; that is reported as NO_SUBJECT and counted as not as stated, since the plan expects an eligible subject in every certificate.

controls.what: the last square's entry deleted
controls.stated: the reader refuses: n stated, n - 1 listed

controls.what: the side written as 2p/2q
controls.stated: read; every value equal; only the side flagged out of lowest terms

controls.what: a fifth scalar in the first square (centre file); the second square given the first's id (witness)
controls.stated: the reader refuses

controls.what: the side written as the number 11.8
controls.stated: the reader refuses

controls.what: the first scalar of the first square given a leading +
controls.stated: the reader refuses

controls.what: a second side key with the value S + 1
controls.stated: the reader refuses: duplicate key

controls.what: (sin, cos) for (cos, sin) in the format sentence (centre file); origin: container-center (witness)
controls.stated: the reader refuses

controls.what: square n given square 1's pose
controls.stated: refused: the overlapping pairs exactly (1, n) and the (k, n) whose original (1, k) overlapped (none in an accepted file); (1, n) at margin exactly -1 and B area exactly 1; every (k, n) at the original margin of (1, k)

controls.what: square 1 translated by (S, 0)
controls.stated: refused: square 1 crosses the right wall at exactly its original right clearance less S, area inside exactly 0; no other square crosses a wall; no overlapping pair

controls.what: square 1 off unit by 1e-30 (its cosine in a centre file, its first corner's x in a witness)
controls.stated: refused: square 1, and only square 1, not a unit square by A and by B

controls.what: transposed, (x, y) -> (y, x)
controls.stated: the original's verdict; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (B, L, T, R)

controls.what: a quarter turn about the box centre, (x, y) -> (S - y, x)
controls.stated: the original's verdict; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (T, L, B, R)

controls.what: mirrored, x -> S - x
controls.stated: the original's verdict; every margin identical; clearances (L, B, R, T) -> (R, B, L, T)

controls.what: every centre multiplied by 99/100, the same box
controls.stated: every margin equals the closed form's (99/100) M - T; the overlapping pairs exactly those with T/M > 99/100; refused iff there is one

controls.what: the side lowered by 1
controls.stated: the side rule: L and B clearances and every margin unchanged, R and T lowered by exactly the amount, the crossings exactly the new negative clearances; refused

controls.what: the side lowered by 1e-30
controls.stated: the side rule

controls.what: the side lowered by 1/q, q its denominator
controls.stated: the side rule

controls.what: the side lowered by W
controls.stated: the side rule; accepted

controls.what: the side lowered by W + 1e-30
controls.stated: the side rule; refused

controls.what: the side set to the claim C
controls.stated: the side rule with the amount S - C

controls.what: the side set to C - 1e-12, the next 12-place value below the claim
controls.stated: the side rule with the amount S - C + 1e-12

controls.what: the packing moved to the corner, the side set to its larger extent
controls.stated: accepted; every margin identical

controls.what: the same with the side 1e-30 lower
controls.stated: refused; every margin identical

controls.what: the first touching pair pushed 1e-30 past along its centre line
controls.stated: refused, that pair at margin exactly -1e-30; no subject when no pair touches

controls.what: the tightest eligible pair (least positive margin whose moved square clears every other square and wall by more than the move's L1 length) closed along its centre line to exact contact
controls.stated: accepted; that pair at margin exactly 0 (A), contact (B); the touching pairs the original's and that one; no overlap

controls.what: the same, 1e-30 past
controls.stated: refused: the overlapping pairs exactly that pair, at margin exactly -1e-30, overlap by B

controls.what: at each wall, the eligible square nearest it (every margin above its clearance plus 1e-30) moved to it along the axis
controls.stated: accepted; that clearance exactly 0, touch by B; the opposite clearance raised by the move; no crossing

controls.what: the same, 1e-30 further
controls.stated: refused: the only crossing that square at that wall, at exactly -1e-30, cross by B

controls.what: the whole packing translated to each wall by its least clearance there
controls.stated: accepted; every margin identical; every clearance shifted by exactly the move

controls.what: the same, 1e-30 further
controls.stated: refused: crossing exactly the squares nearest that wall; every margin identical

controls.what: every centre scaled by lambda* = max T/M about the origin, the packing moved into the corner and boxed at L'
controls.stated: accepted; the touching pairs exactly the pairs with T/M = lambda*; no overlap

controls.what: the same with lambda* - 1e-30, in the box of side L'
controls.stated: refused; the overlapping pairs exactly those with T/M > lambda* - 1e-30

controls.what: every pair closed along its centre line to exact contact and 1e-30 past (pair-level)
controls.stated: A's margin both ways round and the closed form exactly 0 and -1e-30; B contact and overlap both ways round

controls.what: every square moved to each wall and 1e-30 past (square-level)
controls.stated: A's clearance exactly 0 and -1e-30; B touch and cross; B's area inside exactly 1, then below 1

controls.what: the closed form by centres and directions recomputes every margin and clearance
controls.stated: equal to method A everywhere

controls.what: the report's other file, square by square
controls.stated: the same packing: n, the side and every square's corner set equal

controls.what: square 1 moved by (1e-30, 0), against the other file
controls.stated: not the same packing; exactly square 1 unequal

priors: Predictions, not controls, written before any certificate was read by a program: (1) each of the six files is accepted at its side; (2) each report's two files hold one packing; (3) #1015's and #1020's claims are the 12-place ceilings of their sides, and #1017's exact fraction and 15-place decimal equal its file's side, whose 12-place ceiling is the title's 11.800793726616; (4) no pair touches in any file and the side is the packing's extent in one direction; (5) S1e is accepted and S1f refused; (6) G9 is refused; (7) the three reports are one arrangement re-solved, and T-305 another.
measurements: Run after this plan is frozen and before the findings are frozen: r127_check on the six files and on T-305's retained certificate; r127_twin on the three reports; r127_controls on each first file (real, always-accept, always-refuse) and each twin (real); r127_contract over T-305, #1015, #1017 and #1020 in that order (every step's gain and the predecessor's margin); r127_identity over the same four. Then, as a second route and named as the repository's maintained tools, devtools.contraction_margin on each step and devtools.measure_identity on each certificate against the record at 127, both from packing/ with the project interpreter; their receipts are compared with this lane's. After the findings are frozen: the comparison with T-305's retained measure receipts and with any earlier review of these files.
